Articles 2-5 of that act (including the entry-into-force clause, Art. 5) are not part of this text; their content is known only through the portal's footnote. The registry title ('Gesetz zur Durchfuehrung der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 - KI-Marktueberwachungs- und Innovationsfoerderungs-Gesetz') differs from the text's own title ('Gesetz zur Marktüberwachung und Innovationsförderung von künstlicher Intelligenz').

summary.short: German law implementing the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689): names the Bundesnetzagentur as default market surveillance authority, single point of contact and complaints office, assigns sectoral authorities, sets up AI sandboxes, a register and real-world-testing approvals, and sets fines. In force 29 July 2026.
summary.long: The KI-MIG carries out Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 in Germany. The Bundesnetzagentur is the default market surveillance authority; product-safety authorities under Annex I Section A legislation keep AI systems linked to their products; BaFin supervises AI systems directly linked to regulated financial activity of listed supervised firms; Länder authorities cover Länder public bodies and media service providers; an independent KI-Marktüberwachungskammer at the Bundesnetzagentur supervises certain law-enforcement, migration, justice and democracy high-risk systems. Notifying authorities follow existing harmonisation law, with the BSI acting for biometric systems until the Cyber Resilience Act authority is named. The Bundesnetzagentur hosts a coordination and competence centre, the single point of contact, a central complaints office, at least one AI regulatory sandbox, innovation support and a non-public register of critical-infrastructure high-risk systems. Providers must have real-world tests outside sandboxes approved, with tacit approval after 30 days. Market surveillance authorities use the powers of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020. Listed breaches of the AI Act (Art. 21, 27, 45, 86) carry fines up to EUR 50,000; fines under AI Act Art. 99(3)-(5) follow the Administrative Offences Act; public bodies are not fined. The Federal Government evaluates the structure after 18 months and three years.

obligations.summary: Providers and prospective providers of Annex I Section A and Annex III high-risk AI systems must submit the real-world testing plan to the competent market surveillance authority before testing outside a sandbox; the test must take place before placing on the market or putting into service and needs the authority's approval (deemed granted after 30 days without reply).
obligations.conditional_on: Real-world testing under Art. 60 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 outside an AI regulatory sandbox

evidence.quote: müssen sie den Plan für den Test unter Realbedingungen bei der zuständigen Marktüberwachungsbehörde vorlegen

obligations.summary: Before placing on the market or putting into service an Annex III No. 2 (critical infrastructure) high-risk AI system, providers or their authorised representatives must register themselves and the system in the Bundesnetzagentur's non-public register, supplying the Annex VIII Section A information; Länder public bodies are exempt.
obligations.conditional_on: High-risk AI system listed in Annex III No. 2 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689

evidence.quote: müssen Anbieter oder deren Bevollmächtigte sich und das Hochrisiko-KI-System im Register nach Absatz 1 registrieren

obligations.summary: Deployers that are federal public bodies must register themselves and an Annex III No. 2 high-risk AI system in the non-public register before putting it into service or using it, supplying the Annex VIII Section C information.
obligations.conditional_on: Deployer is a federal public body within § 2 of the Bundesdatenschutzgesetz

evidence.quote: müssen Betreiber sich und das Hochrisiko-KI-System im Register nach Absatz 1 registrieren, wenn es sich bei den Betreibern um öffentliche Stellen des Bundes im Sinne des § 2 des Bundesdatenschutzgesetzes handelt

obligations.summary: If a provider or an authorised representative established in Germany ceases business, the person responsible for liquidation or dissolution takes over the documentation-keeping duty of Art. 18(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.
obligations.conditional_on: Cessation of business of the provider or authorised representative

evidence.quote: so hat der für die Liquidation oder Auflösung der juristischen Person Verantwortliche die Pflicht aus Artikel 18 Absatz 1 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689

obligations.summary: The competent market surveillance authorities supervise real-world testing outside sandboxes and approve the test and plan if Art. 60(4) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 is met.

evidence.quote: Die zuständige Marktüberwachungsbehörde genehmigt den Test unter Realbedingungen und den Plan für den Test unter Realbedingungen, wenn die Vorgaben des Artikels 60 Absatz 4 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 eingehalten sind.

obligations.summary: The KI-Marktüberwachungskammer acts with complete independence and submits an annual activity report to the Bundestag (first for 2026, due each 31 March).

evidence.quote: Die KI-Marktüberwachungskammer legt dem Bundestag jährlich einen Tätigkeitsbericht vor.

obligations.summary: A coordination and competence centre at the Bundesnetzagentur supports authorities with expertise on request, coordinates cooperation and uniform answers to horizontal legal questions, facilitates codes of conduct, involves civil society, unions, business, research and the Länder, and provides training and guidance.

evidence.quote: Bei der Bundesnetzagentur wird ein zentrales Koordinierungs- und Kompetenzzentrum für die Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 eingerichtet.

obligations.summary: The single point of contact (Bundesnetzagentur) publishes the authorities' electronic contact addresses, notifies the Commission of the authorities' names and tasks, receives submissions from the AI Office, the public and others and forwards them; market surveillance and notifying authorities supply and update their contact information.

evidence.quote: Die zentrale Anlaufstelle gibt die elektronischen Kontaktadressen nach Absatz 2 sowie ihre eigene elektronische Kontaktadresse öffentlich bekannt.

obligations.summary: Authorities under §§ 2 and 3 fulfil their reporting obligations under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 through the single point of contact using its electronic forms; the Art. 70(6) report is the Federal Ministry for Digital Affairs' responsibility, and BaFin may report directly where legal reasons require.

evidence.quote: erfüllen die nach den §§ 2 und 3 zuständigen Behörden die aus der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 resultierenden Berichtspflichten über die zentrale Anlaufstelle

obligations.summary: Market surveillance authorities must notify the Commission and other Member States of non-compliance not confined to Germany (Art. 79, 81) and of risks despite compliance (Art. 82) without delay, through the Bundesanstalt für Arbeitsschutz und Arbeitsmedizin.

evidence.quote: hat die zuständige Marktüberwachungsbehörde unverzüglich über die Bundesanstalt für Arbeitsschutz und Arbeitsmedizin vorzunehmen

obligations.summary: The Bundesnetzagentur, as central complaints office, receives complaints about infringements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, forwards them to the competent authority and informs the complainant, and sets up an accessible complaints management system; other market surveillance authorities forward or copy complaints they receive.

evidence.quote: richtet die Bundesnetzagentur ein Beschwerdemanagementsystem ein, das leicht zugänglich, barrierefrei und benutzerfreundlich ausgestaltet ist

obligations.summary: Market surveillance and notifying authorities cooperate, inform each other of intended measures, involve data protection authorities, the CRA market surveillance authority and the Bundeskartellamt, and may exchange information including personal data and trade secrets where strictly necessary.

evidence.quote: Die Marktüberwachungsbehörden und die notifizierenden Behörden arbeiten zur Erfüllung ihrer Aufgaben im Rahmen ihrer jeweiligen Zuständigkeiten kooperativ und vertrauensvoll zusammen.

obligations.summary: Before taking measures against a federal or Länder public body found in breach, market surveillance authorities must inform its supervisory authority and give it the opportunity to comment within a reasonable period, unless urgency or overriding public interest requires otherwise.

evidence.quote: so ist dies der für die jeweilige öffentliche Stelle zuständigen Rechts- oder Fachaufsichtsbehörde mitzuteilen und dieser vor Durchführung von Maßnahmen gegenüber der öffentlichen Stelle Gelegenheit zur Stellungnahme innerhalb einer angemessenen Frist einzuräumen

obligations.summary: BaFin staff and persons it engages, and recipients of facts passed on by BaFin, must not disclose or use without authorisation confidential facts, including trade secrets, learned in their work, also after leaving office.

obligations.summary: The CRA market surveillance authority (BSI in the interim) informs the competent AI market surveillance authority of suspected cybersecurity non-compliance of high-risk AI systems; the Bundesnetzagentur and the CRA authority draw up joint cybersecurity testing specifications (BaFin its own for financial entities), and they contribute to Commission guidelines, harmonised standards and common specifications on Art. 15(5).

evidence.quote: erstellen hierfür gemeinsame Vorgaben für die Prüfung der für Hochrisiko-KI-Systeme gemäß Artikel 6 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 geltenden Anforderungen an die Cybersicherheit

obligations.summary: Tax authorities must disclose tax-secret data (§ 30 Abgabenordnung) to market surveillance authorities on request without delay when the request shows the data are needed for tasks under Regulations (EU) 2024/1689 and 2019/1020.

evidence.quote: Die Finanzbehörden haben nach § 30 der Abgabenordnung geschützte Daten den Marktüberwachungsbehörden auf Ersuchen unverzüglich zu offenbaren

obligations.summary: The Bundesnetzagentur carries out innovation-support measures: general information and guidance (especially for SMEs, start-ups and public bodies), case-specific advice to public bodies on AI-system and high-risk status (subject to an administrative agreement covering costs; main considerations published), training, studies, networking and standardisation work.

evidence.quote: Die Bundesnetzagentur führt innovationsfördernde Maßnahmen gemäß der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 durch.

obligations.summary: The Bundesnetzagentur must establish and operate at least one AI regulatory sandbox under Art. 57-58 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, cooperating with affected authorities (the data protection authority assesses Art. 59 requirements).

evidence.quote: Die Bundesnetzagentur errichtet und betreibt mindestens ein KI-Reallabor nach den Artikeln 57 und 58 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689.

obligations.summary: Beyond Art. 62(1)(a) of the AI Act, the Bundesnetzagentur must give research institutions, universities and their spin-offs with a seat or branch in the EU priority access to its sandbox if they meet the eligibility and selection criteria of the Art. 58(1) implementing acts.
obligations.conditional_on: Eligibility and selection criteria set in Commission implementing acts under Art. 58(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689

evidence.quote: auch Forschungseinrichtungen sowie Hochschulen und deren Ausgründungen, die ihren Sitz oder eine Zweigniederlassung in der Europäischen Union haben, vorrangigen Zugang zu dem KI-Reallabor

obligations.summary: The Bundesnetzagentur keeps a non-public register (Art. 49(5) AI Act) of Annex III No. 2 high-risk AI systems and may share its contents only with competent market surveillance authorities, the Commission and other bodies under the AI Act, not with third parties.

evidence.quote: Die Bundesnetzagentur führt ein nicht-öffentliches Register nach Artikel 49 Absatz 5 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 über Hochrisiko-KI-Systeme nach Anhang III Nummer 2 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689.

obligations.summary: The Federal Government must carry out a first evaluation of the supervisory and authority structure within 18 months of entry into force and report the results to the Bundestag.

obligations.summary: The Federal Government must evaluate within three years of entry into force the effectiveness of the structure for an innovation-friendly, low-bureaucracy and effective implementation, considering firms', authorities' and civil-society assessments, and report to the Bundestag.

notes: Competence map (§ 2): Bundesnetzagentur by default; Annex I Section A product authorities for product-linked AI; BaFin for finance-related AI of 25 listed classes of supervised firms (and where the ECB or EBA supervises German-established entities); other financial supervisors under § 2(4); Länder authorities for Länder public bodies (§ 2(6)) and media service providers (§ 2(8)); the KI-Marktüberwachungskammer for Annex III No. 1 systems used for law enforcement, border management, justice and democracy and for Annex III No. 6-8 systems (§ 2(5)), excluding review of Art. 5(2)-(3) and Art. 26(10) authorisations (§ 4(5)).
